faq_q1: How can I read the Quran and surahs offline?
faq_a1: You can navigate to the Holy Quran section and tap the download icon next to any surah to store it locally on your device for offline reading.
faq_q2: How do I restore my adhkar and settings if I change my phone?
faq_a2: You can sign in securely or go to Settings -> Backup Management to export a backup of all your adhkar and achievements and restore them anytime.
faq_q3: What should I do if prayer and adhkar notifications do not work?
faq_a3: Make sure to grant notification permissions in your phone settings and disable battery optimization for the app to ensure alerts trigger accurately on time.
faq_q4: Is the app completely free and without ads?
faq_a4: Yes, Athkar Al-Mumin is a non-profit Islamic application completely free of ads, serving as pure provision for every believer.
